whatIsBivo.heading: What is Bivo?
whatIsBivo.description: Bivo is the first smart app created for those who live racket sports with passion. Technology, experience and specialized physical preparation for padel, tennis, pickleball and badminton. Changing the rules of the game.
paragraphs: With Bivo you get access to workouts designed by fitness trainers who work with elite players, adapted to your level and goals. Whether you are a beginner or a demanding amateur, Bivo gives you the best of professional preparation, adjusted to your pace and needs.

We take the best from pro training and make it available to every player, with personalized programs that help you improve performance, prevent injuries, and take care of your health while enjoying padel, tennis, pickleball or badminton.
Our technology adapts to you so you can train smart, regardless of your starting point.
whatIsBivo.essence: That is our essence: live like a person, train like a pro.

sections.title: SCOPE
content: This online privacy statement of Bivo Training S.L. is public and accessible to all users and customers of Bivo Training S.L., and applies to all websites, applications, events, and other services of Bivo Training S.L., with https://www.bivotraining.com/ being the main site or domain.
It also applies to those documents or messages issued by Bivo Training S.L. that contain or refer to it.
Some services may have their own privacy policies that will apply instead of this Privacy Policy.
Below, we inform you in general terms about the data usage and processing carried out by Bivo Training S.L. for the management of its own services and its website.

sections.title: USE OF THE BIVO TRAINING MOBILE APPLICATION (IOS AND ANDROID)
content: This Privacy Policy also applies to the use of the BIVO TRAINING mobile application.
When the User downloads, installs, registers, or uses the mobile application, this Privacy Policy shall apply together with the additional information requested for registration.

subsections.title: Device permissions
content: The application may request access to certain device functions:
notifications
camera access
photo or storage access
These permissions will always be requested with the user's consent and will be used exclusively for the purposes described at the time of the request.
The use of these permissions will be limited exclusively to the provision of the service requested by the User.

subsections.title: Subscriptions and trial period
content: BIVO TRAINING may offer the User a free trial period to test the services.
The duration of the trial period may vary depending on the promotion applicable at the time of registration.
Once the trial period ends, access to certain services may be restricted until the User contracts a subscription.
Subscriptions may be monthly or annual and will be automatically renewed unless cancelled before the renewal date.
The User may cancel the subscription at any time from their account settings.
Payments, renewals, cancellations, and billing for subscriptions are managed exclusively through the corresponding platform (App Store or Google Play).
BIVO TRAINING does not store or directly process payment data. All financial transactions are handled securely by these third-party platforms.

sections.title: PERSONAL INFORMATION WE COLLECT
content: Information on the use of personal data, in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.
Bivo Training S.L. respects your right to privacy and applies personal data protection policies.
Your personal data is processed with the utmost confidentiality and in compliance with current data protection regulations.

In order for you to receive information and, where applicable, be able to access our services and products, it is necessary to provide your personal data. Otherwise, it will not be possible to provide the service or send the requested information.
We remind you that it is the user's duty to inform us of any changes to their data to keep it updated.
To improve the services we offer, you may receive quality surveys or satisfaction questionnaires. Participation in these is completely voluntary.

sections.title: WHAT IS A COOKIE?
content: A cookie is a small piece of data, usually in the form of text files, that a website requests from your browser to be stored on your device. These cookies serve to remember information about you, such as your language preferences or login details.

Cookies play a fundamental role in the functioning of the internet by providing technical solutions that facilitate user navigation on various websites. It is important to note that they do not cause damage to the user's equipment or device. When enabled in browser settings, they also help identify and solve potential operational problems on the website. In addition to their technical function, cookies can have applications in advertising and analytics.

sections.title: USE OF COOKIES BY THE WEBSITE OWNER
sections.content: BIVO TRAINING uses both first-party cookies, which are created directly by our domain, and third-party cookies, which come from external websites not affiliated with BIVO TRAINING and are owned by third-party companies. These cookies are used for the specific purposes described below.

sections.title: STRICTLY NECESSARY COOKIES
sections.content: These are cookies that allow users to browse a website, platform, or application and use various options and services available on it. For example, these cookies facilitate traffic control and data transfer, identify the user session, provide access to restricted access sections, remember order items, manage the purchase process, allow event registration, ensure security during browsing, store multimedia content, and enable sharing content on social networks.

sections.title: FUNCTIONALITY COOKIES
sections.content: These refer to cookies that allow users to access the service with predefined general features, considering the circumstances of their device or previous choices. This includes aspects such as the selected language, font type, and image layout depending on whether accessed from a computer or mobile device, among others.

sections.title: PERFORMANCE COOKIES
sections.content: These cookies collect data on how visitors interact with the website, such as the most visited pages, detection of error messages on web pages, sections they access, and buttons they select. The information obtained through these cookies does not identify visitors; it remains anonymous as it is aggregated. The purpose of these cookies is to collect statistics and reports used to improve website performance.

sections.title: TARGETING COOKIES
sections.content: These cookies retain data on how users behave online, collected through constant observation of their browsing patterns. This enables the creation of detailed profiles used to personalize advertising, either on this Website or on other third-party websites.

sections.title: LIST OF COOKIES USED BY THE WEBSITE
RETENTION PERIODS
sections.content: The cookies used by BIVO TRAINING will remain on your device for the period required to fulfill their original purpose, without exceeding 2 years. However, you always have the option to delete them using your browser settings, as detailed in the "HOW TO CONFIGURE, REJECT OR BLOCK COOKIES" section of this policy.

sections.title: INTERNATIONAL TRANSFERS
sections.content: Certain personal data collected through third-party cookies may be subject to international transfers. In these cases, we assure you that the necessary security measures will be implemented to preserve the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of such information. For additional details on international transfers made by each third party, we recommend consulting the privacy policies of the third parties through the links provided in the configuration panel.

sections.title: HOW TO CONFIGURE, REJECT OR BLOCK COOKIES
sections.content: BIVO TRAINING has enabled a configuration panel for the cookies used on the Website, which you can access through the following link. Through this tool, the user has the option to accept all cookies, reject all (except technical cookies necessary for website operation), or configure them gradually.
